entities.description: Order grain fact table. One row per order, refunds netted, test orders excluded, currency normalised to USD. This is the order table analytics should build on.

order_id is unique and not null

queries.sql:
select date_trunc('day', created_at) d, count(*) n
from ANALYTICS.STAGING.STG_ORDERS
where created_at >= dateadd(day, -7, current_date)
group by 1 order by 1
select sum(NET_AMOUNT_USD) from ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_ORDERS where PLACED_AT >= date_trunc('month', current_date)
select order_date, sum(amount) from legacy_dw.reporting.orders_snapshot_2024 group by 1
insert into ANALYTICS.STAGING.STG_ORDERS select * from ecommerce_prod.public.orders where updated_at > ?
select EMAIL from ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_CUSTOMER_CONTACTABLE where UNSUBSCRIBED_AT is null
select email, full_name from ecommerce_prod.public.customers limit 100000
